text:
`requirements.md` has been updated with the Gate 1 (revision 1) changes:

1. **AC-8 added**: Specifies the unit test in `packages/common/src/colors.test.ts` that spies on `Map.prototype.set` via `vi.spyOn`, calls `invertDarkModeFilter` on an unreachable pixel (`#0000ff`) and a reachable pixel (`#d3d3d3 = applyDarkModeFilter("#1e1e1e")`, computed prior to installing the spy), asserts `set` was never called, and restores the spy (`mockRestore` in a `finally` or `afterEach`) without exporting `DARK_MODE_COLORS_CACHE`.
2. **NFR-4**: Linked to `AC-8` (`verified by AC-8`).
3. **In scope (item 2)**: Added the cache-untouched spy test in `packages/common/src/colors.test.ts`.
4. **Out of scope (item 9)**: Added exporting `DARK_MODE_COLORS_CACHE` (or any test-only accessor to it).
5. **All other sections (`AC-1`..`AC-7`, Open questions, etc.)**: Kept unchanged.
